service: Cambridge AS Level Paper Maker - Agent Gateway

tools.name: get_subjects
tools.description: Get available Cambridge AS subjects, code definitions, and syllabus overview.

tools.name: get_syllabus_tree
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive bilingual (Chinese & English) syllabus chapters, topics, and subtopics for a subject.

subject.description: Cambridge subject code (9708 for Econ, 9702 for Physics)

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search exam questions by subject, paper type, year range, syllabus section, confidence, or keyword.

keyword.description: Keyword matching evidence, topic, or paper

tools.name: semantic_vector_search
tools.description: Semantic natural language vector search. Dispatches dense cross-lingual embeddings to retrieve relevant past paper questions.

query.description: Natural language query in Chinese or English, e.g. '需求价格弹性计算' or 'internal resistance and terminal pd'

tools.name: generate_exam_paper
tools.description: Automatically generate a standardized Cambridge mock paper or assignment with balanced syllabus mark distribution.

targetMarks.description: MCQ: custom question count in either mode, 1 mark each; defaults 9708=30, 9702=40. Assignments: custom marks, independent subquestions. 9708 exams: Essays answer 40/printed 80; DR+Essays answer 60/printed 100.

tools.name: get_syllabus_coverage
tools.description: Per-learning-objective coverage of the question bank: question count, weighted marks, mark share, first/last year and year count for every syllabusRef. Includes objectives with zero questions so gaps are visible. Use this to build a syllabus map and a coverage table.

paperType.description: Restrict to one paper tier; omit to use all papers

includeEmpty.description: Include objectives with zero matching questions (default true; set false for a covered-only view)

tools.name: get_kp_questions
tools.description: List real past-paper questions for one syllabus objective, with marks, tag role, marking evidence and page-anchored links to the question paper and mark scheme. Use this to pick genuine worked examples instead of inventing them.

syllabusRef.description: Syllabus objective code, e.g. '2.1', '10.1.5'. Prefix matching: '2.1' also matches 2.1.x

tagId.description: Exact knowledge-point tag id, e.g. 'KP120'. Provide instead of syllabusRef when the objective code is not unique

role.description: Tag role filter; 'primary' means the objective is the main target of the question

limit.description: Max questions to return, capped at 100

tools.name: get_kp_trend
tools.description: Year-by-year frequency of one syllabus objective: question count, weighted marks and number of papers per year. Use this to state how often something is actually examined, with an explicit sample range.
